node.title: Re: Non White space function
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
m{http:// (S+) }

You put whitespace around the capturing group (perhaps you meant to use the /x modifier?) and you forgot the backslash on the \S.

Perhaps you want to use [mod://Regexp::Common::URI::http] or [mod://URI] instead of making your own regex.
